svg.title: TOPAK A2 — Two domains, one membrane: Build(Contain) → Run(Contain)
svg.desc: Build produces artifacts and Run operates them. The arrow is authority flow; the parentheses are a refinement boundary (specification conjunction plus existential hiding of internal variables). Contain is one component instantiated twice, not a third domain.
svg.text: TOPAK · A2

Build produces artifacts and Run operates them. The arrow is authority flow; the parentheses are a refinement boundary (specification conjunction plus existential hiding of internal variables). Contain is one component instantiated twice, not a third domain.

text.tspan: At the gate: outside every proof, carried as assumption or declaration

svg.text: The trust anchor issues rules (Issue, Resign are environment events no principal can express). At archetype custody its key-holders are removable only with their own consent, so they sit at the gate (B14).
The evictability test (ADR-0002 A2): a principal is anything evictable by an authority other than itself; whatever is not is at the gate. Resignation is not eviction.

The operator is no longer at the gate: it holds a seat of kind operator and is a principal, its first lease from a quorum (ADR-0050, provisional). At the reference a BOOTSTRAP socket seats in place of the quorum, and whoever reaches it can seat (ToO §7.10; G10 §8).
issued rules: rosters, quorum, keys
same rules epoch fences both domains
Authors the specifications, policy, floors, bundles, mechanism releases and Personas that Run is later judged against. The
Byzantine threat lives here (the inversion).
Operates promoted artifacts against external state. Its budget is hard: the propagation window W is about a second, so Run is
human-on-the-loop (HOTL).

text.tspan: Principals, one seat each, leased per round

svg.text: thinker seats author; observer seats read, emit and, on the veto roster, deny; grant seats (human, Mediated)
read, emit and vote.
Per artifact, author and voters are disjoint; the author is recused by the Vote envelope.

text.tspan: Principals, one seat each, leased per round

svg.text: A thinker seat holds all three variants; an observer seat Consult and Report (ADR-0043 §2).
There is no terminal variant: a Run round ends when its lease ends; a Run seat cannot abstain.
operator, either domain, a person and no other seat: Regrant, Renew, AttestGates, EndRound, Revoke,
FenceEpoch, and no authoring variant (ADR-0037 A4; ADR-0050 §4).
Adds need a live lease and a live peer; EndRound and Revoke a live lease or a fresh sign-on; FenceEpoch a live
lease (ToO §7.10).
operator, as in Build; AttestGates is Build's (ADR-0037 A4).
emergency, Run only, a person for one round: Consult, Actuate, Report, each action signed with the person's
key; activated by the break-glass roster's quorum, no successor, no renewal (ADR-0037 A3; ADR-0052 §1, §2).
Resolve a content-addressed object in the pinned corpus root
Write into the round-scoped workspace
Run a tool allowlisted by name and digest: the whole attack surface
Append to the principal's round topic
Offer the sealed workspace for promotion, or abstain
Cast a promotion vote
Ingress, no effect: ref resolves in the pinned Run root
Effect: tool allowlisted by name and digest; its entry declares the
channel it opens, and the tool host reads the target from that entry
(ADR-0049 §5). A read of live state is an Actuate
Effect: the principal's own round topic, this epoch and round, unsealed
No variant name is common to Build and Run (ADR-0022 A2); only
the carrier is shared

text.tspan: Build's ingress: what reaches the Thinker

svg.text: The Listener delivers the task, each admitted Read, and the round's tool list, rendered by the mechanism from the
entries the lease may call (ADR-0037 A2; ADR-0048).
Read is not labelled (ToO §2.10). Each entry has ADR-0049's one form (ADR-0022 A3).
Four items and nothing else: the task, each Consult's content, each Actuate's result, the tool list (ADR-0043
A1). Each carries a label, a function of its source.
Delivered clear with its label or as a handle, a name and no bytes; a handle may be an argument the tool host
resolves (ADR-0047). R5–R7 forbid an outward Actuate over clearSet (ADR-0041 A1).
The round's topic opens with the tool list, so the Observer is given what its Thinker was (ADR-0042 A1).

text.tspan: Detection couples the gate, not each admit

svg.text: Build favours consistency over latency; detection only has to finish before the gate clears (ADR-0021, ADR-0039).
A promotion stalls unless the author's cell Observer reported coverage to the seal.
Floor entry R3: every Actuate or Report under a Thinker needs a live cell Observer; Consult is exempt
(ADR-0039, ADR-0041 §2). A dead or slow Observer stops its own Thinker and nothing else.
An emergency seat is not coupled: it is not a thinker seat (ADR-0039 A2, provisional with ADR-0052).
The only crossing: one signed, promoted
artifact: a bundle, a mechanism release
(including floor changes) or a Persona.
A quorum grant (ADR-0024): every counted
grant seat must grant; a timeout is never a
grant.
Votes bind to (artifact digest, gate-evidence
digest, rules epoch).
Gates enable voting; they do not vote.
Submit(digest)
promoted
What is promoted may be a seating:
principal, seat, Persona, bundle revision,
confinement, alphabet. When the tally
completes, the mechanism grants the first
lease (ADR-0024 A3).
Not built at the reference (ToO §7.1, §7.10).
No variant name.
No principal: a seat belongs to one domain.
Nothing unpromoted: Run never loads an
artifact Build did not promote.

text.tspan: Effects reach the world only as admits

svg.text: Effects: exactly {tool invocation, principal
emission} (ADR-0015).
Authority changes: exactly {promotion, anchor
issuance}.
Break-glass is not a third kind: a lease whose
activation is a grant by a roster's quorum
(ToO §4.1; ADR-0052, provisional).
Denials are not ordered, and they are
recorded.
Build agents write what Run is judged against. The failure that matters, silent abstention, a vacuously true
predicate and green gates, is a Build failure.
Every Build choice that looks expensive pays for that.
Proved: a property class over the action vocabulary and its envelope, by mechanical extraction.
Assumed, operationally discharged: effect exclusivity, the principal reaches the world only through the
alphabet (ADR-0015).
Safety theorems quantify over Contained principals; a Mediated one (shell, egress, git) gets attribution and
authorization, not containment.
No real principal is Contained: the reference's lookup has members only in a SIMULATED rung-3 run under a
test-issued criterion, a witness and not a claim (G10 §2.3; ADR-0033 A7).
The Run profile is in force (ADR-0034 A2 with ADR-0042 §6, Batch 30): P4 replaced by channel fidelity, owned
by the tool host's Wasm runtime. Run principals are still Mediated in fact: the fourth conjunct, ADR-0035, is
Proposed (ToO §2.3, §2.9).
An operator and an emergency seat are Mediated by design (ADR-0050 §1; ADR-0052 §1).
(provisional), ADR-0052 §1, §2 (provisional); ADR-0033 A7, A8, A11; G10 §1, §2.3, §2.5, §8; boundary register B1, B2, B3
